tapToSwap: Ukucofa kubekanye ukutshintsha umhlaba wakho okanye uhlele iinkcukacha
ramHighPerf: Ukusetha kwangaphambili kokusebenza okuphezulu - kunokubangela ukushisa okukhulu
ramLowPerf: Ukusetwa kwangaphambili kokusebenza okuphantsi — kugcina ibhetri
releaseTrain26Body: Ukwi Minecraft %s . Sisaphucula i-26.x kwi-PocketCraft — tshintshela kwi-1.21.x ukufumana ulwazi olungcono.
maxPowerModeDesc: Isebenzisa i-RAM epheleleyo kunye nonikezelo olukhulu lomgama. Inokubangela ukutshisa.
mobSpawningDesc: Wehlisa ubalo lwequmrhu ukuze usebenze ngcono
forceExternalJvmDesc: Sebenzisa i-JVM yangaphandle endaweni ye-bundled enye
openFolderDesc: Khangela iifayile zeseva kumphathi wakho wefayile
managePluginsDesc: Lawula iiplagi ezifakiweyo kunye neepakethi zemithombo
useAddButton: Sebenzisa i Yongeza iqhosha ukungenisa ifayile, okanye ufake enye kwikhusi lokufumana.
deleteConfirmDesc: Oku kususa ifayile kuguqulelo lomncedisi wangoku.
pluginsTip: Layisha iBukkit/Spigot/Paper ehambelanayo .jar plugins. Fumana iiplagi kwi spigotmc.org okanye hangar.papermc.io
tapToAddPlugin: Thepha 'Yongeza i-Plugin' ukuze ulayishe ifayile ye-.jar
noInternetConnection: Akukho nxibelelwano lwe-intanethi. Nceda ujonge inethiwekhi yakho.
hubModLoaderDesc: Le nguqulo yomncedisi ayisebenzisi umlayishi wemod exhaswayo. Tshintshela le seva kwiFabric okanye iQuilt ukufaka iimods.
hubSectionDownloadedDesc: Lawula oko sele kugcinwe kule nguqulo yomncedisi.
hubSectionDiscoverDesc: Ziziphumo ze-intanethi kuphela eziboniswa apha. Iimatshisi ezifakelweyo ziphawulwe wena.
hubDeleteDesc: Oku kuya kuyisusa ngokusisigxina ifayile kolu guqulelo lomncedisi.
hubSearchRetry: Uphendlo lugcinwe kwi-cache kwaye lulinganiselwe, ngoko ke ukuzama kwakhona okomzuzwana kudla ngokusebenza.
hubDetailApplyDesc: Qala kwakhona iseva emva kokutshintsha iiplagi okanye iipakethi.
worldsStopBeforeReset: Misa umncedisi phambi kokuseta ngokutsha ihlabathi.
worldsSlotHint: Slayida ngasekhohlo ukucima. Iihlabathi ezisebenzayo zinokucinywa kuphela xa umncedisi emisiwe.
worldsImportGuideDesc: Cofa ukubona ukuba zisebenza njani ilizwe kunye nemilinganiselo yokungenisa elizweni.
worldsResetDesc: Khetha into oza kuyicima. Iiplagi, iimods, iifayile zoqwalaselo, kunye neserver.properties ziya kugcinwa.
worldsResetRowPlayers: Idatha yomdlali (idatha yomdlali, izibalo, ukuqhubela phambili)
worldsResetPreserved: Ihlala igciniwe: iiplagi /, mods/, config/, server.properties, kunye neefayile zoqwalaselo.
worldsRestoreDesc:
Oku kuya kubuyisela: 
 - Ihlabathi kunye nedatha yedimension 
 - Iiplagi, iimods, kunye nezibonelelo pack 
 - Uqwalaselo lweseva kunye nesetingi 
 
 Iifayile zakho zangoku zeseva ziya kubhalwa ngaphezulu. 
 Qinisekisa ukuba umncedisi umisiwe phambi kokubuyisela.
worldsDeleteWorldActive: Cima %s ? I-PocketCraft izakutshintshela kwelinye ilizwe eligciniweyo kuqala.
worldsDeleteWorldInactive: Cima %s ? Oku kususa ihlabathi kwindawo yokugcina.
worldsImportGuideText1: Ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kwe-Aternos kunokulayishwa njenge-ZIP ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo: i-Overworld, i-Nether, kunye ne-The End.
worldsImportGuideText2: Uninzi lwezinye ii-backups zehlabathi sele zibandakanya yonke imilinganiselo kwindawo enye, ngoko ke ukuthathwa kwelizwe elinye eligcina ilalela lanele.
filesAddAnotherWorld: Yongeza elinye ihlabathi phambi kokuba ucime eli.
filesSeedDialogDesc: Faka imbewu yehlabathi lakho. Yiyeke ingenanto kwilizwe elingenamkhethe.
filesDeleteWorldDesc: Oku kuyakucima umphelo %s kwaye utshintshele kwelinye ilizwe eligciniweyo ukuba likhona.
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Sekela iiseva zoHlelo lweJava simahla. 
 Akukho PC efunekayo. Dlala nabani na.
onboardingStep1Body: Iphepha libaleka ekuhlaleni kwifowuni yakho kwaye lisebenzisa inkumbulo osele unayo.
onboardingStep2Body: I-PocketCraft ikunika idilesi yogqithiso olulodwa abangaqhagamshela kuyo abahlobo.
onboardingStep3Body: Abadlali boHlelo lweJava baqhagamshela ngqo kwi-relay kunye nokukhuhlana okuncinci.
onboardingImportSubtitle: Yiza nehlabathi lakho, iiplagi, kwaye ulungelelanise nawe. Hayi ukuqala phantsi.
onboardingImportWorldBody: Thumela ngaphandle ukusuka e-Aternos, yehlisa indawo yokugcina kwi-PocketCraft, kwaye uqhubeke.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Phinda usebenzise iifayile zejar ezifanayo. Isitaki sakho seplagin sihamba nawe.
onboardingImportConfigBody: server.properties, whitelist, kunye nofikelelo lomsebenzisi zihlala zinjalo.
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: Hayi usetyenziso olukhutshiweyo. Le yi-toolkit yomncedisi yokwenyani.
onboardingCrossPlaySubtitle: PocketCraft ixhasa iJava kunye ne-Bedrock yokudlala ngokunqamlezayo xa ibhulorho yenziwe yasebenza kulungiselelo lomncedisi wakho.
onboardingCrossPlayJavaBedrockBody: Abahlobo kwiPC kunye neselfowuni banokujoyina ilizwe elinye kunye ngokudluliselana.
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraAppBody: Yabelana ngedilesi yomncedisi wakho kwaye abadlali banokuqhagamshela kuhlelo lwabo kwangoko.
onboardingCrossPlayExperimental:
⚠️ Uphawu loMfuniselo - Dlala ngokubona Kwakho 
 
 Umdlalo ohlukeneyo usaqhutywa. Iibugs kunye nemiba yozinzo inokuthi yenzeke njengoko eli nqaku alikaxhaswa ngokusemthethweni. Sebenzisa ngomngcipheko wakho.
onboardingRegionSubtitle: Khetha iseva yokudlulisela ekufutshane nabadlali bakho. Ungatshintsha oku kamva kwideshibhodi kwakhona.
onboardingPermissionsSubtitle: Oku kusetyenziselwa ubume beseva, inani lomdlali, kunye nohlaziyo olubalulekileyo lwangemva ngelixa umncedisi wakho esebenza.
onboardingPermissionsCardBody: Ibonisa ubume beseva kunye nokubalwa komdlali ngelixa umncedisi eqhuba.
onboardingPermissionsStatusWarn: Ufikelelo lwesaziso luyafuneka kweli nyathelo. Cofa iqhosha elingentla, emva koko uyivumele kwi-Android.
onboardingPermissionsStatusTap: Cofa iqhosha elingentla, emva koko wamkele imvume yemvume ye-Android yokuvula Okulandelayo.
onboardingGoogleSubtitle: Sayina ngoku ukuze uvule ii-backups zabucala zikaGoogle. Ungatsiba oku kwaye ugqibezele ukuseta kuqala.
onboardingGoogleStatusDesc: Ii-backups zigcinwe ngaphakathi kwifolda yakho ye-Google Drive yabucala. I-PocketCraft ayikwazi ukubona okanye ifikelele kwezinye iifayile zakho zeDrayivu.
onboardingGoogleConnectedDesc: Ihlabathi leseva yakho, iiplagi ezifakiweyo, kunye nesetingi ziya kuzigcina ngokuzenzekela ku: %s
onboardingSetupBackupNotice: Ungabuyisela ii-backups zehlabathi kamva kwiiSetingi nanini na ulungile.
